# Zachary Leifer | zacharyleifer.com

> Zachary Leifer is a Las Vegas-based commercial growth and transformation executive who helps companies
> create more predictable value from data, digital transformation, technology and AI. He has served as
> Chief Marketing Officer at 1/ST Technology, Chief Commercial Officer at PokerAtlas, and Vice President,
> Corporate Information Technology at Las Vegas Sands, after leading digital marketing and eCommerce at
> The Venetian Resort Las Vegas. Harvard Business School Advanced Management Program (2026). Speaker,
> executive advisor and Board Candidate, open to Chief Marketing Officer, Chief Commercial Officer, board
> and advisory roles.

## Writing

- [Why Data and Digital Transformations Fail: Evidence from 82 Senior Executives](https://zacharyleifer.com/blog/why-data-transformations-fail/):
  Original survey research from his Harvard Business School Advanced Management Program capstone (Leadership
  Impact Project) on why data and digital initiatives fail to deliver, how the pattern carries into AI, and
  the readiness conditions associated with stronger delivery.
- [What Running Corporate IT Taught Me About Running Marketing](https://zacharyleifer.com/blog/marketing-to-corporate-it/):
  Four lessons from moving out of Vice President, Digital Marketing & eCommerce into Vice President, Corporate
  Information Technology at Las Vegas Sands, a Fortune 500 company.
- [The Org Chart Is Being Rewritten. Is Your Company Ready?](https://zacharyleifer.com/blog/org-chart-rewritten/):
  How AI is reshaping the traditional management pyramid, and why companies should redesign their structure
  intentionally.
- [AI Is Already in Your Company. Is It Creating Enterprise Value? Is It Secure?](https://zacharyleifer.com/blog/ai-enterprise-value/):
  Why AI adoption is running ahead of AI governance in many organizations, and the questions boards and CEOs
  should be asking.
- [All articles](https://zacharyleifer.com/blog/)

  - Chief Marketing Officer, 1/ST Technology (2020–2024)
  - Vice President, Corporate Information Technology, Las Vegas Sands (2019–2020)

  & Management, Cornell University

## Impact Metrics

- 1/ST Technology (Chief Marketing Officer, 2020–2024): 67% revenue growth and 22% EBITDA CAGR over four years
- 1/ST Technology: 56% reduction in customer acquisition cost and 73% improvement in LTV/CAC
- 1/ST Technology: board-approved marketing budget increased from $8M to $15M through direct board-level
  briefings and ROI forecasting
- 1/ST Technology: new wagering app generated $60M in handle (total amount wagered) and $4M in net gaming
  revenue within 10 months of launch
- Las Vegas Sands / The Venetian: $13M capital investment in digital transformation initiatives that generated
  $36M in incremental direct-channel revenue
- The Venetian: 24 consecutive months of year-over-year growth, 50% increase in return on advertising spend,
  and 18% lift in CRM conversion
- PokerAtlas: 14% increase in registered players and 18% increase in B2B customers in nine months
- Launched a DTC healthcare venture in eight weeks and scaled it from $0 to $200K in gross revenue in five months
